clips.title: The story
paras: Calor is a dedicated resident of Darkshire who aids the Carevin family in defending Duskwood. Operating under the direction of Jonathan Carevin, he actively coordinates efforts to hunt down the vicious worgen stalking the gloomy forests. Adventurers looking to push back the ravenous beasts haunting the woods often find their assignments through him.

Stationed within the beleaguered settlement of Darkshire, Calor works closely with Jonathan Carevin, one of the town's prominent defenders. Amid the endless gloom and creeping terrors of Duskwood, Calor devotes himself to supporting the Carevin household's mission: eradicating the supernatural horrors encroaching upon the town's perimeter before the remaining townsfolk are slaughtered.

Calor's primary duty centers on confronting the feral worgen prowling the woods, particularly around blighted areas like the Rotting Orchard. These ferocious wolf-men are far more aggressive and dangerous than common beasts, slaughtering travelers and patrols alike. Calor enlists capable fighters to cull their ranks and investigate their origins, desperate to stem the bloodthirsty tide.
